name: CHAOS SPACE MARINES: FORGEFIEND
description: Forgefiends are fused with enormous rotary cannons that fire fist-sized phosphor shells, or else with ancient artefact ordnance perverted to vomit ectoplasma from the innards of the beast. With such weaponry, they scythe down masses of enemy troops and blast glowing craters into the toughest opposition.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds one Forgefiend for your Chaos Space Marines, World Eaters, or Thousand Sons armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. These predatory Daemon Engines excel in dealing damage from afar. They can be armed with a pair of ectoplasma cannons to take on heavily armoured targets or Hades autocannons to thin out enemy hordes. You can also choose from two different heads – one with snapping jaws, or another with an in-built ectoplasma cannon. The kit alternatively builds a Maulerfiend.</br></br>This kit comprises 67 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 120mm by 92mm Oval Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
